messages:
tara: Heads up — hotfix PR #7890 needs 2x LGTM before 11:30 PT cutoff. It's blocking the cutover for the kv-cache stability fix. Anyone around to give a quick second review? :eyes:
kevin: I can do one. taking a quick look now.
maria: I saw a CI flake earlier on this PR, but looks green now. I can give a second after a small nitcheck.
tara: thanks @kevin @maria. if either of you find anything blocking, call it out — we may need to hold the cutover.
kevin: small comment on a logging fmt, not blocking. patch LGTM after that.
aj: pinging in case primary approvers are OOO — I can approve but prefer someone from runtime team to double-check perf impact.
release-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR #7890 (commit abc123). Merge window: closes in 27m.
sasha: I’m oncall in 30m but can carve out 10m now. Will review end-to-end tracing and approve if fine.
maria: nit fixed, pushed. CI re-run queued.
release-bot: CI: re-run passed. smoke-test: ok on canary.
kevin: LGTM (second eye). marking for merge but note: the change increases max buffer by 8KB — should be fine, monitored.
tara: awesome. @dena can you confirm we have rollback playbook ready if the canary shows memory regression?
dena: yes — rollback steps documented and we have an autoscaling leash for canary. If OOM rate > 0.5% within 10m, ops will rollback.
tara: perfect. proceeding to merge in 5m before cutoff. merging command:```/merge priority hotfix-7890```
aj: thanks everyone. I’ll watch the canary for the next 15m. :thumbsup:
